definition.en: Earth’s crust and the rigid rock at the top of the mantle.
definition.zh: 地壳和上地幔最上部的坚硬岩石。

definition.en: A moving piece of the lithosphere. It can carry both land and ocean floor.
definition.zh: 岩石圈中移动的一块，可以同时承载陆地与海底。

definition.en: A region where neighbouring plates move relative to each other.
definition.zh: 相邻板块发生相对运动的地区。

definition.en: A boundary where plates move apart.
The sinking of oceanic lithosphere beneath another plate.
definition.zh: 大洋岩石圈沉到另一板块之下的过程。

definition.en: A boundary where plates mainly slide sideways past each other.
definition.zh: 板块主要沿水平方向彼此错动的边界。

definition.en: A fracture along which rock moves. Sudden slip can cause an earthquake.
definition.zh: 岩石沿其移动的破裂面。突然滑动可以引发地震。

definition.en: The surface point directly above where an earthquake’s underground rupture begins.
definition.zh: 地震地下破裂开始处正上方的地表点。

definition.en: A measure of earthquake size. It differs from the shaking felt at a place.
definition.zh: 衡量地震规模的量，与某个地方的摇晃强弱不同。

definition.en: The strength of shaking or its effects at a particular place.
definition.zh: 某个地点的摇晃强弱或受影响程度。

definition.en: A series of long waves caused by water suddenly being pushed aside.
definition.zh: 海水突然被推移后形成的一系列长波。

definition.en: The highest level water reaches onshore, measured above sea level.
definition.zh: 海水到达岸上、相对海平面的最大高度。

definition.en: A large hollow formed when part of a volcano collapses. It differs from an ordinary summit crater.
definition.zh: 火山部分塌陷形成的大洼地，不同于普通山顶火山口。

definition.en: A collection of volcano records within the Holocene period. A listed volcano need not be erupting today.
definition.zh: 按全新世范围收录的火山资料，列入目录不表示今天正在喷发。

definition.en: A popular name for a region around the Pacific. Different sources define its extent differently.
definition.zh: 太平洋周边地区的通俗名称，不同资料划定的范围不同。
